scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run typecheck:e2e
scripts.test:unit: node --test artifacts/api-server/tests/profileIdentity.test.ts && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run test:android-preflight && bash scripts/tests/check-ios-native-large-text-readiness.test.sh && bash scripts/tests/check-native-large-text-evidence.test.sh && bash scripts/tests/validate-branding-command.test.sh
